# Tests

This layer contains tests for various components and functionalities of the Excalidraw application.

## Key components

| File | Purpose | Main definitions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`excalidraw-app/tests/LanguageList.test.tsx`](../../excalidraw-app/tests/LanguageList.test.tsx) | Defines TestApp and tests language list functionality. | `TestApp` |
| [`excalidraw-app/tests/MobileMenu.test.tsx`](../../excalidraw-app/tests/MobileMenu.test.tsx) | Tests mobile menu functionality. |  |
| [`excalidraw-app/tests/collab.test.tsx`](../../excalidraw-app/tests/collab.test.tsx) | Tests collaboration features. |  |
| [`excalidraw-app/tests/firebase.test.ts`](../../excalidraw-app/tests/firebase.test.ts) | Tests Firebase integration. |  |

## How it works

The `LanguageList.test.tsx` file defines a `TestApp` component and tests the functionality of the language list. The `MobileMenu.test.tsx` file tests the mobile menu functionality. The `collab.test.tsx` file tests the collaboration features, and the `firebase.test.ts` file tests the Firebase integration.

## Configuration

- Configuration files: `excalidraw-app/vite.config.mts`.
